integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a brightly lit Chinese wedding banquet hall with round tables draped in red tablecloths, balloons, and double-happiness decorations, guests laughing and toasting as the bride and groom stand at the center in wedding attire, flanked by the best man, bridesmaid, and cheering relatives. The camera holds mostly static with a small slow push-in as the grinning best man theatrically holds up an empty shoe box and announces: <d>[Chinese] 新娘的鞋藏好了，想接走可没那么容易！</d> Guests erupt in playful jeers while the bridesmaid covers her mouth laughing. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the groom playing along, pretending to search under chairs and behind flower arrangements as guests point and give exaggerated false hints; the bride watches with an amused, knowing smile. [Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to the groom walking straight to the best man, tapping his shoulder, and pulling the shoe out of the best man's bag with a confident flourish as he says: <d>[Chinese] 我早就知道了——鞋就在你包里！</d> The camera quickly punches in on the best man's stunned, wide-eyed face while the crowd bursts into laughter and applause. [Shot 4] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to the groom kneeling and slipping the shoe onto the bride's foot; she laughs as guests cheer and raise their glasses, and the frame settles on the joyful group for the final beat.

overall_soundscape: Festive banquet chatter, clinking glasses, and warm laughter fill the hall. Playful jeers and whistles rise during the shoe hunt, followed by a burst of applause and cheering when the shoe is revealed and slipped onto the bride's foot.

non_diegetic_music: Light, upbeat comedic music with plucked strings and playful woodwind flourishes at a brisk tempo, pausing briefly for the twist reveal before swelling into a cheerful finish.
